title: MartinezPeon2024
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery of a right-hand ball squeeze at three graded force levels (10%, 40%, and 70% of maximal voluntary contraction). Data were acquired with a 14-channel Emotiv EPOC headset at 128 Hz, with five cued imagery trials per 40 s recording and two recordings per force level per subject. The dataset supports characterization and classification of motor imagery force levels for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: Participants imagined squeezing a ball with the right hand at 10%, 40%, or 70% MVC. Each 40 s recording contained five 5-s cues, and each force level was recorded twice per subject. EEG was recorded with a wet saline-electrode Emotiv EPOC (14 channels, 128 Hz, standard 10-20 montage, P3/P4 reference).
